entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So after Shiho Suzui, you did it again[n]for someone you barely knew?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You were sent away twice, almost[n]reported to the police... and yet[n]you still wanted to save him?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Moreover, you ended up in a museum[n]instead of a castle this time...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You're still going to maintain this[n]rubbish about changing someone's[n]heart by stealing their Treasure?
It's the truth.
Take it how you will.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Very well. The truth behind this tale[n]of yours will be clear once your[n]conspirators are in custody.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now then, tell me about this new[n]member who joined your group.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: There's no point in being stubborn.[n]It will only damage your position.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: The identity of Madarame's pupil can be[n]easily discovered with a little investigation.
Go right ahead.
I'm not telling.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So you won't sell out your accomplice?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Fine. There's still much more that[n]I want to hear.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: It was around this time that the Phantom[n]Thieves began to truly gain popularity.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Lies flooded the internet—things like,[n]"The Phantom Thieves saved me too,"[n]or, "I got a calling card"...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: For heaven's sake... those lies made[n]the collection of intel take almost[n]ten times longer.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Now, your next target was this man...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Junya Kaneshiro.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He doesn't compare to the previous two.[n]Even the police had been struggling to[n]apprehend him.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: So, exactly how did you take down[n]such a well-guarded criminal? Tell me.
